title: frances cma cgm charge inland emergency fee due lower river levels 2026 08 21
text:
BRUSSELS, Aug 21 (Reuters) - French container shipping giant ​CMA CGM said on Friday ‌it will apply an "inland emergency fee" as the low water ​levels in the Rhine ​and other European rivers disrupt inland ⁠barge traffic.
